summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing Week 52 data from the open-label sentinel cohort of the pivotal Phase 2 reACHin Trial of once-weekly TransCon CNP (navepegritide) in infants aged 0-2 with achondroplasia, presented at ESPE 2026. The filing reports foramen magnum stenosis stabilization/improvement, including AFMS stability or improvement in all seven infants and a mean +3.15 mm sagittal diameter change, plus a +0.42 supine length Z-score change and 9.9 cm/year annualized growth velocity. No acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, strategic reviews, or capital-structure events are disclosed; this is ordinary clinical development disclosure with no deal terms.
